Bug 11 PASS — TopBar renders [data-testid=topbar-messages] between LanguageSwitcher and notifications bell. Clicking navigates to /marketplace/messages. Badge testid=topbar-messages-badge only rendered when unreadMsgs>0 (verified badge absent when count=0).

Bug 12 PASS — VehicleProfile ShareMenu. DESKTOP (1440x900): [data-testid=vehicle-share-menu] visible next to button; backdrop+close button DOM-present but hidden (sm:hidden class). MOBILE (375x812): bottom-sheet fixed inset-x-0 bottom-0 (bbox x=0,w=375,bottom=812), backdrop visible + tapping backdrop closes the sheet, Zamknij close button visible.

Bug 13 PASS — PublicVehicle. As OWNER (auth token set, is_owner=true): [data-testid=vehicle-qr] rendered inside share section, owner-stats marker visible. As GUEST (localStorage cleared): vehicle-qr absent, owner-stats absent. NOTE: test vehicle had public=false so full guest page was 404 not-found — QR gating logic (v.is_owner &&) confirmed via source inspection.

Bug 14 PASS (static) — /app/frontend/src/i18n/index.js domainDetector.lookup(): 'sharago.pl' + subdomains → 'pl'; 'sharago.com', '.co.uk', '.app', '.io' + subdomains → 'en'; any other host (preview.emergentagent.com, localhost) → undefined. Detection order: localStorage > domain > navigator > htmlTag — user's manual pick always wins.
REGRESSION Iter 42/43 PASS — POST /api/vehicles with ~1MB base64 photo (base64 payload ~1.33MB) accepted; ~2MB (base64 ~2.66MB) rejected 413.
action_items: Consider stripping base64 from owner.avatar in /api/swaps/deck response (same treatment as vehicle.cover_photo). Currently the deck endpoint still emits 'data:image/png;base64,...' inside owner.avatar — same class of bug as Iter 43 but on a different field. Minor perf concern (deck payloads grow with avatar sizes).

OPTIONAL: Make the test vehicle 'test-public-2020' actually public so /vehicles/{slug} guest scenario can be end-to-end verified in future runs. Currently vehicle.public=false so guest fetch 404s — Bug 13 owner-side + source review is sufficient but not full e2e.
critical_code_review_comments: TopBar.js:47-58 — unread messages poller fetches /marketplace/messages/threads every 60s. Combined with existing /notifications poll (line 41-43), authenticated pages now do 2 background HTTP calls on mount and 1 every minute. Consider merging into a single /api/notifications/summary endpoint returning both counts to halve the request rate.

VehicleProfile.js:264 ShareMenu — the responsive class chain uses both `fixed inset-x-0 bottom-0` AND `sm:static sm:absolute sm:right-0 sm:top-full` — the `sm:static` and `sm:absolute` overlap in cascade order. In practice Tailwind resolves `sm:absolute` (later in class list). Works, but the redundant `sm:static` is confusing — remove for clarity.
swaps.py — /deck response leaks base64 owner.avatar (see backend_issues.minor). _safe_cover_url is applied to vehicle.cover_photo but not to owner.avatar dict.

PlateBlurDialog.js — good hardening. Consider adding a `passive: false` note in a comment near preventDefault to explain why React's synthetic event system is safe here (React's onPointerDown listener is non-passive by default, so preventDefault works).
i18n/index.js — domainDetector covers .pl/.com/.co.uk/.app/.io. If future domains like sharago.de or sharago.fr are added, this list must be extended. Consider a data-driven map.
